title: Finite evaluation of the unary support adjunct
statement: For the normalized datum d, level m, invertible prime hl, and realized system operations o,z, every separated locally finite-type quasi-compact f:X→Y, compactification c, and integral constructible K satisfy ev_Y(supportReduction(K)) followed by evaluatedSupport(K) equals reductionEvaluation at the datum support of K followed by the included prescribed supportAdjunction.left component. All notation is the explicit construction of [def-sf-integral-projection-evaluation-factors] and [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data]. No tensor, second input, or projection map occurs.

theorem integralProjectionSupportEvaluation
    (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k)) (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left) :
    (evaluation (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
        (FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.supportReduction
          D C E d.higher hl o z f c K) ≫
      (evaluatedSupport d m o f c K).hom =
    (reductionEvaluation d m Y ((d.higher.integral.support f c).obj K)).hom ≫
      (finiteInclusion (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
        (((d.integralNormalization.reduction m).supportAdjunction f c).left.hom.app K)
